from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingStart(BaseModel):
    """
    A single monthly data point extracted from a document.
    Since documents revise historical data, the same month may appear multiple times.
    The 'release_date' allows the downstream agent to apply the 'most recent report prevails' rule.
    """
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents, in YYYY-MM format")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date this report was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used to determine precedence")
    total_housing_starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    single_family_starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Single-Family Starts")
    five_plus_unit_starts: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Starts in Buildings with Five or More Units")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_housing_starts: list[MonthlyHousingStart]
